tools.name: web2md_convert
tools.description: Convert any public URL to clean, readable Markdown. Strips ads, navigation, and boilerplate. Returns LLM-ready text for RAG, research, and content extraction. Free: 10/day. Unlimited: set WEB2MD_LICENSE_KEY env var. Buy: https://grantshatz.gumroad.com/l/mpkqyq ($1+)

tools.name: web2md_convert_batch
tools.description: Convert multiple public URLs to clean Markdown in one call (Web2MD Pro). Requires a WEB2MD_LICENSE_KEY env var (buy: https://grantshatz.gumroad.com/l/mpkqyq $1). Returns a list of {url, success, markdown} results. Free tier is single-URL only.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "web2md_convert" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
